title: Context caching not working with Agent Engine (VertexAiSessionService drops cache_metadata) #4698
relevance_note: Concrete failure report showing how session persistence bugs can break context caching, forcing repeated cache creation and higher token/cost.
reason_included: Includes named ADK components (VertexAiSessionService, ContextCacheRequestProcessor) and a precise non-reuse failure mode tied to metadata persistence.

claim_snippets.claim_text: The reporter claims this has "never worked" with VertexAiSessionService (tested ADK 1.19.0 and 1.25.1).

The issue provides a repro where in-memory sessions reuse a `cache_name` on the second turn, while Agent Engine sessions create a new cache each turn with a different fingerprint and no `cache_name` reuse.

The issue reports `VertexAiSessionService` does not persist `cache_metadata` or `usage_metadata` when round-tripping Event objects to/from Agent Engine, causing `ContextCacheRequestProcessor` to create a new cache on every invocation instead of reusing an existing cache.
